column1: # When a levy uses an armor set ability that a key (or a double-tap) starts. One row per set; a set with no row is never used. Tab separated.
# policy: DASH (God Slayer dash), RAM (Solar Flare dash), AT_TARGET (cast at the target), FIGHT (once a fight is on), FIGHT_TOGGLE (on in a fight, off after it), NEVER.
# params (key=value;...): minDist / maxDist (tiles to the target), tough=1 (a boss, or a target with toughLife or more max life), mana (mana the levy keeps for it),

#   dodge=1 (DASH: also dash when a hit is coming), dodgeTicks (how far ahead a coming hit counts), loop (DASH: 1 steers back into the target after passing it, 0 runs out straight), maxRise (RAM: tiles the target may sit above or below), minShields (RAM), gap (RAM: ticks between dashes), calm (FIGHT_TOGGLE: ticks out of a fight before it is switched off).

column5: God Slayer and Auric Tesla: dash through the target and steer back into it; a coming hit is dodged by the dash
Solar Flare: dash into a close enemy (150 melee damage and a flare burst per enemy, one shield spent)
Forbidden: the sandstorm lands on the target
Vortex: stealth on in a fight, off once it is over
Demonshade enrage (the enemies it tags only change colour)
Forbidden Circlet tornado at the target
Desert Prowler smoke (Lights Out crit on the next shot)
